calls.title: Leandro Baptista Lemos and Chris Sanders
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the integration of GrowthBook with current systems, emphasizing the deployment of the edge SDK for tracking and data serialization. Tariq elaborated on avoiding duplicate tracking through deferred methods, while Chris highlighted the importance of experiment assignment queries for analytical correctness. Onboarding and support mechanisms were outlined, including Slack channels for communication, and a phased training plan was proposed. The team discussed the architecture for multiple environments and the limitations of Snowflake schemas, planning further investigation for multi-schema support. AA testing was recommended to assure data integrity before launching live experiments, reinforcing the need for robust metrics definition and filtering based on user attributes.
